summary: Tally lesson with the no-cross trap is solid: explicit 4+1 cross convention, real Grade 1 misconception, character voice consistent, optional puppets, worksheet practises all three success criteria with a transfer task (draw your own 12). Math authenticity strong but stops short of Level 4 — does not invite children to invent or compare strategies, nor cite research-grounded misconception names. One Level 3 here, others clear Level 4.
